craft_notes: Sthāyin: womb-joy (sauḥ veiled). Triplet keeps all uncut. Close: own form. Rejected: naming sauḥ aloud — killed: decoding in lore; splitting the triplet — killed.

lines: This is the womb, told in all Tantras evermore —
with fourteen joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma,
O fair of hip, the heart of Bhairava's own form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ yoniḥ samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam | tṛtīyam brahma suśroṇi hṛdayam bhairavātmanaḥ
